args.sql:
DO $$
DECLARE
    v_enum_exists INT;
BEGIN
    -- Check if the enum type already exists
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_enum_exists
    FROM pg_type
    WHERE typname = 'battery_efficiency';

    -- If the enum type does not exist, create it
    IF v_enum_exists = 0 THEN
        EXECUTE 'CREATE TYPE battery_efficiency AS ENUM (''Low'', ''Medium'', ''High'')';
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE (
    device_id VARCHAR,
    efficiency_value NUMERIC,
    efficiency_classification battery_efficiency
) AS $
DECLARE
    v_device_id VARCHAR;
    v_efficiency_value NUMERIC;
    v_efficiency_classification battery_efficiency;
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        di.devregistry AS device_id,
        (ts.battcapmah / NULLIF(di.pwractmw, 0)) AS efficiency_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (ts.battcapmah / NULLIF(di.pwractmw, 0)) > 100 THEN 'High'::battery_efficiency
            WHEN (ts.battcapmah / NULLIF(di.pwractmw, 0)) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'::battery_efficiency
            ELSE 'Low'::battery_efficiency
        END AS efficiency_classification
    FROM
        deviceidentity di
    INNER JOIN
        testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
    WHERE
        di.conntype IN ('Wireless', 'Bluetooth');
END $
LANGUAGE plpgsql;

SELECT * FROM classify_battery_efficiency();
